derivation: The other half of E13: an inverted interval. Before the verifier existed this lowered to a domain of width -4, so a sampled coordinate resolved to NaN, evaluations were orphaned from every cell, and the atlas still drew a suspicious finding at risk 0.000 - a picture of the harness's own broken arithmetic presented as evidence about a model. The refusal is the result, and it has to be an error rather than a warning, which is what the audit checks here.
expect: an error at the IR gate, reported in the results document
